initial_combinations.generation_rule: Replace projected duplicate in its original position with next scrambled Sobol point in remaining free coefficient box; exact float64 identity; dimensions3 max8,2 max6, parent coverage descending then parent ID and canonical child signature.

interpretations.action_order: Inherited all-slow/all-clear/all-reverse, then goal-yield in frozen passage and robot-ID order. Multiple relevant passages retain this order.
interpretations.entering_end: First forward route/expanded-rectangle entry. If the blocking disk is approached beside the rectangle with no such entry, entering end is nearest to requesting robot; endpoint ties use negative canonical axis.
interpretations.two_sided_goal_yield: Nearest end to the completed robot; exact distance ties use negative canonical axis.
interpretations.mouth_zero_perpendicular: Inherited route-right fallback for a completed robot, relative to selected endpoint direction.
interpretations.deduplication: Replace duplicate at its original candidate position with next unique scrambled Sobol point, not reorder successful candidates.

implementation_correction: 按第二节结束条件：让路角色不会因离开终点容差而取消；持续到不再满足阻挡请求条件，且不把自己当作阻挡请求者。修正前新定义覆盖结果未用于修改规则。
authority_quote: 结束：不再有这样的r时，这一项为0，f由朝目标拉回终点。
import_relocation: Byte-identical production numerical retry dependency privately loaded under the identical canonical module name; no tolerance, solver, constraint, or retry statement changed. Prior freeze preserved ininputs/import_relocation.
utility_relocation: Canonical utils package is a byte-identical private copy. Parent init contains only its original docstring; numeric submodules load at their original point. All external research-code dependencies used by current controllers are now private, with shared production libraries and virtualenv read-only.
